_doc: The chain lamp's surfaces (docs/kb/art/creatures/act3/chain_lamp.md). cage: the brass frame, rings, base plate, domed cap (going bronze_patina toward its crown, by vertex colour), drip cone and the cap's eye; louvre: the eight brass leaves, worn bright on their free edges, their inner faces lit_ceramic reflectors (vertex colour); lamp: the salt-glass core and the bound light in it, glimmer_bound, steady (the light never changes: the louvres do; creatures README rule 3, color_script.md rule 2); chain: the dry lacquer_black iron links, the ring and the shackle; pin: the shackle pin, its hairline spawn_wound crack the weak point (ADR 0151), closed, a slow weak-point pulse. Colours are palette.json swatches; write_materials.py on game/shaders/creature/creature.gdshader.
